presets.ultra: Everything, full-size textures, longest view. Hours to build, and only an ultra card runs it.
presets.high: Everything at 512 px. The default, and what the reference city is validated at.
presets.performance: Everything, smaller textures and fewer drawn triangles. For an 8 GB card at high resolution.
presets.medium: 60 % of the trees, 70 % of the props, 3 km view. A mid-range card.
presets.low: Roads, buildings and a third of the foliage. What runs on a laptop.
